biggest_catch: Election Day runs from 6:30am until after the 8pm close (14+ hours) for $175-$200 including training pay.
catches: Election-period work only; Election Day is ~14+ hours (6:30am until after the 8pm close).
Pay varies by assignment and training ($175-$200 for the day, training also paid).
Must be a registered voter of Northampton County.
Additional compensation and mileage for bringing supplies back to the Government Center.

eligibility: Registered voters of Northampton County; mandatory training before serving; 17-year-old high school students may serve as clerk/machine inspector via the Student Poll Worker Program.
notes: Supply returners get additional compensation and mileage; student poll workers: $100 (8 hrs) or $125 (10 hrs).
